metadata.title: Andrea Losavio | Senior Software Engineer & FDE
metadata.description: Freelance software engineer. I build software for companies and startups: architecture, web, mobile, backend and AI. From the idea to the finished product.

hero.title: Andrea Losavio
hero.subtitle: Senior Software Engineer & FDE
hero.description: I have been building software for companies and startups since 2018. I take care of everything it takes to bring a product from the idea to the market: architecture, development, technical decisions and support for the team.

howIWork.title: Let's get to know each other
howIWork.subtitle: Three things about me that a CV cannot really say.

listen.title: I start with questions, not with code
listen.text: Before writing a single line I want to understand the problem. I talk to the people who know the business, put everything down on paper and turn their needs into clear technical decisions. That way the project starts with the right ideas and no surprises halfway through.
listen.alt: Andrea Losavio designing a solution at the whiteboard with a colleague from the Quido team

team.title: I become part of the team
team.text: I am not a supplier who delivers and disappears. I stay inside the group, listen to feedback and put it back into the product. When the work is over, the team can carry on by itself what we built together.
team.alt: Andrea Losavio with the Quido team at the company offices

beyond.title: I don't ship things I wouldn't use
beyond.text: If a technical choice is wrong I tell you, even when it is awkward. If something can be done better I do it again. What I hand over is stuff I would put online under my own name, and in fact I do.
beyond.alt: Andrea Losavio being interviewed in the Story Time television studio on Canale Italia

architecture.title: Architecture and backend
architecture.text: APIs, databases and infrastructure built to handle growth. For one company I built the foundations every later project was born on.

web.title: Web platforms
web.text: Products thousands of people use every day, quick to use and stable over time.

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.text: Apps for iOS and Android, from the first screen to the release on the stores.

ai.title: AI and automation
ai.text: Systems that use AI models to take repetitive work off people: agents, integrations and custom tools.

product.title: Product decisions
product.text: I sit next to the people who run the company to decide what to build first, with which technology and with which team.

enterprise.title: Enterprise projects
enterprise.text: From 2018 to 2022 on platforms for large international clients, at IBM, Deloitte Digital, DOING and Minsait.

products.title: I do not build only for other people
products.subtitle: Two apps of mine, published and used by real people.

youCouldBeNext.title: You could be next
youCouldBeNext.subtitle: Every project above started with a simple chat.
youCouldBeNext.text: You have seen what I did for other people. Now I am curious to find out <highlight>what we can build together</highlight>.

recrowd.name: Recrowd S.r.l.
recrowd.quote: "Our collaboration with Andrea was consistently solid from start to finish. Over time, he became a key contributor to the platform's evolution — improving performance, refining the platform, and ensuring a smooth, reliable user experience."

quido.name: Quido S.r.l.
quido.description: artificial intelligence for private equity and M&A
quido.quote: "Andrea managed to make sense of a highly complex product like Quido — where finance meets AI — with impressive clarity. He helped shape a sophisticated yet accessible interface that highlights the intelligence behind the platform. A professional who understands both data logic and the importance of design and user experience."

ravenn.name: Ravenn S.r.l.
ravenn.description: event logistics and hospitality management platform
ravenn.quote: "Our collaboration was short but impactful. Andrea handled the entire platform end-to-end, delivering a smooth and intuitive experience for managing logistics, check-ins, and hospitality."

studioBargiggia.name: Studio Bargiggia
studioBargiggia.quote: "Our previous website suffered from poor design, confusing navigation, mismatched colors, and performance issues. He completely rebuilt it from the ground up, creating a clean, fast, and modern showcase site that truly represents our firm. Thanks to his work, our online presence finally matches the professionalism of our studio."

brainplatform.name: Brainplatform S.r.l.
brainplatform.quote: "Worked on a short-term collaboration to support our digital product initiatives."

anonymous.name: Anonymous
anonymous.quote: "He built a platform that completely transformed how we work: interactive maps, tobacconist management, agent assignments, and an admin dashboard — all in one place. He perfectly balanced a fast and user-friendly interface. His focus on performance and user experience is what truly set his work apart."
